Downard family · Person

Robert T. Downard

1948–2009

Open in the family tree

Born
September 12, 1948 · Vernal, Utah
Died
February 13, 2009 · Murray, Utah
Burial
Bountiful City Cemetery
Occupations
Law enforcement

Vietnam-era U.S. military service is reported by family; branch, dates and deployment details await documentation. Recorded treasured memories of Grandma D: “She kept the family together. I have nothing but fond memories of her.”

Robert married Judy Freestone on March 30, 1968. They later had their marriage sealed in the Ogden Temple. He worked in law enforcement and enjoyed spending time with his grandchildren, going to Utah Jazz games, traveling, reading, and golfing with friends.

Robert died at age 60. His obituary named 11 grandchildren and recorded that his son Robert Todd died before him. The obituary lists Bountiful City Cemetery as his burial place.
